name: Minitiger Virtual Sync
description: Server-side companion for Minitiger Web. Stores and serves Minitiger virtual-library configuration and custom virtual-library media.
overview: Server-side virtual-library sync companion for Minitiger Web.

versions.changelog: Adds experimental external VLC playback support for Minitiger, including playback-job sync, resume/progress reporting, session handling, audio/subtitle support and episode auto-next. Also includes admin messages, season repair/removal tools and translation improvements.
Adds Minitiger profile synchronization, shared avatar support, background translation services and API controls, plus stability and compatibility improvements for Minitiger Web 18.18.5c.
Initial public Minitiger plugin repository release for Jellyfin 12.1.
